f3_program: collection("george.pizzas", "pizza", "george", source("George purchased 3 small and 2 large pizzas"))
collection("george.pizza_slices", "pizza_slice", "george", source("A small pizza can gives 4 slices, and a large pizza gives 8 slices.  George purchased 3 small and 2 large pizzas"))
observe(at("pizza.small.slice_yield", "per_pizza"), 4, "count", source("A small pizza can gives 4 slices"))
observe(at("pizza.large.slice_yield", "per_pizza"), 8, "count", source("a large pizza gives 8 slices"))
add("george_purchase_small_pizzas", "george", at("george.pizzas.small.count", "current"), 3, source("George purchased 3 small"))
add("george_purchase_large_pizzas", "george", at("george.pizzas.large.count", "current"), 2, source("2 large pizzas"))

rate_relation(at("george.pizza_slices.small.count", "initial"), at("pizza.small.slice_yield", "per_pizza"), event_field("george_purchase_small_pizzas", "quantity"), source("A small pizza can gives 4 slices, and a large pizza gives 8 slices.  George purchased 3 small and 2 large pizzas"))

rate_relation(at("george.pizza_slices.large.count", "initial"), at("pizza.large.slice_yield", "per_pizza"), event_field("george_purchase_large_pizzas", "quantity"), source("A small pizza can gives 4 slices, and a large pizza gives 8 slices.  George purchased 3 small and 2 large pizzas"))

sum_relation(at("george.pizza_slices.count", "initial"), at("george.pizza_slices.small.count", "initial"), at("george.pizza_slices.large.count", "initial"), source("A small pizza can gives 4 slices, and a large pizza gives 8 slices.  George purchased 3 small and 2 large pizzas"))
consume("george_eat_pizza", "george", at("george.pizza_slices.count", "current"), 3, source("George would like to eat 3 pieces"))
offset("bob.pizza_slices.consumption_quantity", event_field("george_eat_pizza", "quantity"), 1, "count", source("His friend Bob would like to eat one more piece than George"))
consume("bob_eat_pizza", "bob", at("george.pizza_slices.count", "current"), "bob.pizza_slices.consumption_quantity", source("His friend Bob would like to eat one more piece than George"))
fraction_of("susie.pizza_slices.consumption_quantity", event_field("bob_eat_pizza", "quantity"), 1, 2, source("Susie will eat half as many as Bob"))
consume("susie_eat_pizza", "susie", at("george.pizza_slices.count", "current"), "susie.pizza_slices.consumption_quantity", source("Susie will eat half as many as Bob"))
consume("bill_eat_pizza", "bill", at("george.pizza_slices.count", "current"), 3, source("Bill, Fred and Mark would each like 3 pieces"))
consume("fred_eat_pizza", "fred", at("george.pizza_slices.count", "current"), 3, source("Bill, Fred and Mark would each like 3 pieces"))
consume("mark_eat_pizza", "mark", at("george.pizza_slices.count", "current"), 3, source("Bill, Fred and Mark would each like 3 pieces"))
query("remaining_count", "george.pizza_slices", "current")
collection("isabela.cucumbers", "cucumber", "isabela", source("Isabela bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils"))
collection("isabela.pencils", "pencil", "isabela", source("Isabela bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils"))
add("isabela_purchase_pencils", "isabela", at("isabela.pencils.count", "current"), "isabela.pencils.purchased_count", source("Isabela bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils"))
add("isabela_purchase_cucumbers", "isabela", at("isabela.cucumbers.count", "current"), 100, source("bought 100 cucumbers"))
multiple(event_field("isabela_purchase_cucumbers", "quantity"), event_field("isabela_purchase_pencils", "quantity"), 2, source("Isabela bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils"))
observe(at("isabela.cucumbers.list_unit_price", "current"), 20, "dollar", source("with both costing $20 each"))
observe(at("isabela.pencils.list_unit_price", "current"), 20, "dollar", source("with both costing $20 each"))
percent_less(at("isabela.pencils.discounted_unit_price", "current"), at("isabela.pencils.list_unit_price", "current"), 20, source("got a 20% discount on the pencils"))

product_relation("isabela.cucumbers.purchase_cost", at("isabela.cucumbers.list_unit_price", "current"), event_field("isabela_purchase_cucumbers", "quantity"), source("Isabela bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils, with both costing $20 each. If she got a 20% discount on the pencils and bought 100 cucumbers"))

product_relation("isabela.pencils.purchase_cost", at("isabela.pencils.discounted_unit_price", "current"), event_field("isabela_purchase_pencils", "quantity"), source("Isabela bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils, with both costing $20 each. If she got a 20% discount on the pencils and bought 100 cucumbers"))

sum_relation("isabela.purchase.total_spent", "isabela.cucumbers.purchase_cost", "isabela.pencils.purchase_cost", source("Isabela bought twice as many cucumbers as pencils, with both costing $20 each. If she got a 20% discount on the pencils and bought 100 cucumbers"))
query("value", "isabela.purchase.total_spent")
observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "monday"), 4, "hour", source("On Monday, he studies for 4 hours"))
multiple(at("tristan.study.duration", "tuesday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "monday"), 2, source("studies for twice this long on Tuesday"))
observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "wednesday"), 3, "hour", source("On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday he studies for 3 hours each day"))
observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "thursday"), 3, "hour", source("On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday he studies for 3 hours each day"))
observe(at("tristan.study.duration", "friday"), 3, "hour", source("On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday he studies for 3 hours each day"))
observe(at("tristan.study.target_duration", "week"), 25, "hour", source("a total of 25 hours over the week"))

sum_relation("tristan.study.monday_through_friday.duration", at("tristan.study.duration", "monday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "tuesday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "wednesday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "thursday"), at("tristan.study.duration", "friday"), source("On Monday, he studies for 4 hours then studies for twice this long on Tuesday. On Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday he studies for 3 hours each day"))

difference_relation("tristan.study.weekend_remaining.duration", at("tristan.study.target_duration", "week"), "tristan.study.monday_through_friday.duration", source("He wants to study for a total of 25 hours over the week and divides the remaining amount of study time evenly between Saturday and Sunday"))
fraction_of(at("tristan.study.duration", "saturday"), "tristan.study.weekend_remaining.duration", 1, 2, source("divides the remaining amount of study time evenly between Saturday and Sunday"))
fraction_of(at("tristan.study.duration", "sunday"), "tristan.study.weekend_remaining.duration", 1, 2, source("divides the remaining amount of study time evenly between Saturday and Sunday"))
query("value", at("tristan.study.duration", "saturday"))

collection("sit_ups.performed", "person_sit_up_count", "exercise_session", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute, and Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes, and Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
member("sit_ups.performed", "barney.sit_ups.performed.count", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
member("sit_ups.performed", "carrie.sit_ups.performed.count", source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
member("sit_ups.performed", "jerrie.sit_ups.performed.count", source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
observe(at("barney.sit_ups.rate", "current"), 45, "sit_up_per_minute", source("Barney can perform 45 sit-ups in one minute"))
multiple(at("carrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("barney.sit_ups.rate", "current"), 2, source("Carrie can do twice as many sit-ups per minute as Barney can"))
offset(at("jerrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("carrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), 5, "sit_up_per_minute", source("Jerrie can do 5 more sit-ups per minute than Carrie can do"))
observe(at("barney.sit_ups.duration", "session"), 1, "minute", source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
observe(at("carrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), 2, "minute", source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
observe(at("jerrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), 3, "minute", source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
rate_relation(at("barney.sit_ups.performed.count", "session"), at("barney.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("barney.sit_ups.duration", "session"), source("Barney does sit-ups for 1 minute"))
rate_relation(at("carrie.sit_ups.performed.count", "session"), at("carrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("carrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), source("Carrie does sit-ups for two minutes"))
rate_relation(at("jerrie.sit_ups.performed.count", "session"), at("jerrie.sit_ups.rate", "current"), at("jerrie.sit_ups.duration", "session"), source("Jerrie does sit-ups for three minutes"))
query("sum", "sit_ups.performed", "session")
